test_strategy: Adopt a hybrid testing approach combining Jest and React Testing Library for frontend validation (React DnD interactions, UI verification) and Supertest with Jest for backend API testing. PostgreSQL test database will be used with transaction-based rollback per test. Integration tests verify end-to-end data persistence and sharing workflows. Key types include Unit, Integration, E2E, Performance, and Security tests. CI/CD pipeline ensures automated regression via GitHub Actions.

test_cases.title: Drag and Drop Field Creation
test_cases.description: Verify that users can drag and drop field types into form layout using React DnD.
preconditions: User is on form editor page
steps: Drag a text field from available components panel to the layout area
Drop the field into the canvas
test_cases.expected_result: The text field appears in form layout correctly and can be edited.

test_cases.title: Validation of Drag-and-Drop Boundary Conditions
test_cases.description: Ensure React DnD correctly handles invalid or overlapping drop positions.
steps: Attempt to drop a field outside the designated form area
test_cases.expected_result: No field is added for invalid drop. Error visually shown or no change.

test_cases.title: Form Saving and Retrieval
test_cases.description: Confirm form details are persisted and correctly reloaded from PostgreSQL.
steps: Create a form with multiple field types
Reload editor or fetch via GET /api/forms/:shareId
test_cases.expected_result: Form data and layout retrieved match the saved configuration.

test_cases.title: Shareable Link Generation
test_cases.description: Verify unique shareable link generated for each saved form.
steps: Inspect generated link in response JSON
Open link in a new tab
test_cases.expected_result: Unique URL with shareId provides public view of the form, accessible without authentication.

test_cases.title: Submit Form Response
test_cases.description: Validate form response submission and storage in PostgreSQL.
steps: Navigate to form using share link
Fill in all fields with valid data
test_cases.expected_result: Response stored under corresponding formId in Response table.

test_cases.title: Input Validation during Submission
test_cases.description: Test form submission rejection on invalid data (missing required answers).
test_cases.expected_result: Submission fails with validation message. No response saved.

test_cases.title: Analytics Data Aggregation
test_cases.description: Verify analytics endpoint returns correct total submissions for a form.
preconditions: Multiple responses stored for one form
test_cases.expected_result: Count matches number of stored Response records for that form.

test_cases.title: CSV Export Functionality
test_cases.description: Validate generation and formatting of CSV file for collected responses.
steps: Check response content type and file attachment
test_cases.expected_result: CSV contains all stored responses with correct headers and data.

test_cases.title: Performance of CSV Export on Large Dataset
test_cases.description: Measure time and memory for CSV export with >10,000 responses.
preconditions: Populate form with large number of responses
steps: Measure request latency and memory usage
test_cases.expected_result: Export completes within acceptable threshold (<5s) and system remains stable.

test_cases.title: API Security Test - SQL Injection Prevention
test_cases.description: Ensure PostgreSQL queries are protected from SQL injection.
steps: Send malicious query string like 'shareId=1 OR 1=1'
test_cases.expected_result: Request rejected or handled safely without executing injected SQL.

test_data_requirements: Sample form definitions in JSON format with various field types (text, number, dropdown, date, checkbox, file upload)
Test responses dataset covering completed, partially completed, and invalid submissions
Large response dataset for performance tests
Unique shareId examples for link testing
automation_approach: Frontend automation using Cypress for E2E UI testing, simulating drag-and-drop and visual validation. Backend automation leveraging Jest and Supertest for REST API validation with a mock PostgreSQL test DB using Sequelize transactions rollback. CSV export tests to include file content verification via temporary storage. CI integrated with GitHub Actions running tests on PR merges and nightly builds.
coverage_goals: Target 85% unit test coverage, 75% integration coverage, and 100% functional flow coverage across user stories. Ensure drag-and-drop interactions, data persistence, sharing, submission, analytics, and exports are validated for both happy and edge scenarios.
